notes.title: Menu Refresh & Updated Levels
notes.content:
A small-ish update, after a 5 year (!) hiatus.

1) The 3 levels formerly exclusive to the itch.io platform are now available on Steam
2) Fixed a loading bug
3) Added a notification to checkout the upcoming Skipper2
4) Changed the level menu layout to resolve scrolling issues.

Thanks for playing Skipper - excited to show everyone Skipper2!

notes.title: Skipper Get's Some Love - New Valentine's Day Levels!
notes.content:
It's been a while since the last update, but Skipper is absolutely still alive!

This patch covers a couple of gameplay bugs, adds the ugly but functional Screen selector on startup, and fixes the tiny UI size on hidpi and 4k screens.

It also brings the first new levels to Skipper in over a year, two Valentine's  themes levels. Update your game or grab a copy and check it out!

Skipper will see a smattering of new levels this year, so stick around and check back for updates around each major Holiday.

notes.title: Released!
notes.content:
Skipper has been released! Super exciting, and really glad to get this out there. Watching the streams on Twitch I noticed a few people getting stuck on some of the "boss" levels.

If you get stuck or need a hint, pop into the community Discord https://discord.gg/nGXS8RR . It's a hard game, don't worry if you get stuck.
